name: twitter-mcp
description: A Model Context Protocol server allows to interact with Twitter, enabling posting tweets (with images), and searching Twitter.
long_description: MCP server for X (Twitter) that enables AI assistants to post tweets, upload images, and search Twitter using natural language via the Twitter API.

API_KEY.title: Twitter API Key

API_SECRET_KEY.title: Twitter API Secret Key
API_SECRET_KEY.description: The consumer API secret key from your Twitter Developer portal

ACCESS_TOKEN.title: Twitter Access Token
ACCESS_TOKEN.description: The access token generated for your specific account from the Twitter Developer portal

ACCESS_TOKEN_SECRET.title: Twitter Access Token Secret
ACCESS_TOKEN_SECRET.description: The access token secret generated for your specific account from the Twitter Developer portal
